Agent Name: Verification_Expert

Reason for Mistake: The first major error was introduced when the Verification_Expert created a **mock CSV dataset** instead of obtaining real historical weather data for Houston from 2020–2023. This violates the task requirement to base the answer on accurate historical data. The later 35.00% result is therefore not a valid real-world estimate; it is only the percentage from randomly generated mock temperatures, so it directly leads to the wrong solution.
